sample.question_description: Predict the final bin for a package under current sensors.
sample.question_preview: Package P1 is yellow and square. With the current S1 and S2 sensors, which bin will it reach? Options: [1] color-only bin [2] reject bin [3] shape-match bin
sample.question:
Package P1 is yellow and square. With the current S1 and S2 sensors, which bin will it reach?
Options:
[1] color-only bin
[2] reject bin
[3] shape-match bin
sample.analysis: At S1, compare color yellow with sensor yellow. It matches and goes to S2. Route: feeder -> S1 -> S2 -> shape. Final bin is shape-match bin, so choose option 3.

rules: Packages enter S1 first. If package color matches the S1 color sensor, it goes to S2; otherwise it goes to the reject bin.
At S2, if package shape matches the S2 shape sensor, it goes to the shape-match bin; otherwise it goes to the color-only bin.
